data.gender_notes: Sanat is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sanat is derived from the Sanskrit root word 'San', which means 'eternal' or 'timeless'. The name signifies the eternal and infinite nature of the universe and the divine consciousness that pervades it. The name Sanat carries the meaning “Eternal, Timeless” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sanat usually hope their child will grow to embody eternal, timeless and live with faith, good character and purpose.
